test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate 2025 (CBT 1): Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: If 'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B', 'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B', 'A * B' means 'A is the father of B', 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the mother of B', then which of the following options signifies that P is the grandmother of Q?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18c229b95a3ebc533a00a9ba233fa84c0c776bcc5633c66072ae9ba67e11d7ec.png] 

Decoding the code:

 
 

 **Symbols**
 -
 +
 * 
 ÷ 
 
 

 **Coded as**
 brother 
 sister 
 father
 mother
 
 

Let's check the options one by one.

Option 1) R + P * O + S * Q

It means that R is the sister of P, P is the Father of O, O is the sister of S, S is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38cc8bb410406aaa9f87ff6fcf258ad9585b02870c5187b4555fad841e3634e6.png] 

Option 2) R - P * O - S ÷ Q

It means that R is the brother of P, P is the father of O, O is the brother of S, S is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f5b5637eb3e39d3435e6e568e48d272e2a166442b1839488bc1016e33855566.png] 

**Option 3) R - P ÷ O + S * Q**

It means that R is the brother of P, P is the mother of O, O is the sister of S, S is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96bef731b7563b979ff53f002bbad5e1d3af5752e72e0fd790638a63dfbea94d.png] 

**Here, P is the grandmother of Q.**

Option 4) R - P * O + S ÷ Q

It means that R is the brother of P, P is the father of O, O is the sister of S, S is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65284b8f4d8f234c902fff82997b06826b571040549c338e99262e61b412bb60.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
